_comment: Local tastytrade template. Copy to config.json. broker is the only place the broker is named, and tasty is this one's; no launcher, flag, or platform check sets it. tasty_orders=sandbox (the default) sends to api.cert.tastyworks.com. tasty_orders=production is real money and requires tasty_data=production. mode dry (the file's default) and alerts never send; mode live auto-approves and nothing waits on a human. There are no credentials here: the TASTYTRADE_* secrets stay in the environment or under secrets/. base_dir is left out, so SPX_NOON_HOME names the home directory.
_rules: 15m closes 12:00-1:00 PM ET, the first close beyond the prior day's high or low, 1 spread. Skip the day if any 15m close from 10:15 through 11:00 ET was already beyond those levels. Long nearest 80 delta. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. Exit at +8 SPX points or flat 2 hours after the entry bar, whichever comes first. No premium target and no stop. Tastytrade does not chase a missed fill. None of this is a config key.
_wrap: Read-only log summary: python -m spx_noon wrap. It does not connect and does not send orders. After the markdown report it upserts one High Noon row on the shared Google Sheet; see _sheets.
_sheets: The 16:20 wrap's one daily row for Boi 'High Noon' on the sheet Candle and Fly already share. Columns, in order: Date, Boi, Traded, P&L after fees, Worst (always empty), What happened. The key is (Date, Boi), so a second wrap on the same date replaces the row. sheets_spreadsheet_id is the document id above and is not a secret. sheets_credentials is a path to the Google service-account key file; blank means <home>/state/sheets-service-account.json. The key is never a key in this file: set SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_JSON (the whole json, kept in memory only), or SPX_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a path. Order: the json, then sheets_credentials, then those two variables, then the default path. The row goes on the Derek Comp tab, on a local run and on Render. There is no tab setting. Install the client with pip install -e '.[sheets]'. A missing key or any sheet error leaves the markdown report in place, adds one status line, and still exits 0.
